info.description: This course provides an introduction to aesthetic and the phylosophy of arts for students and provides them with the knowledge and skills to communicate their ideas and processes in a visual form more effectively. As a means of questioning and applying fundamental theories, concepts and techniques, students conduct research and produce practical projects. The course examines the basic elements of visual communication and how context shapes visual forms production and reception.
info.studentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

2. Actively participate in class activities

3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

5. Read the textbook in advance

6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

materials.materialDescription: Introduting Aesthetics and the philosophy of art.
materials.author: Darren Hudson Hick

clos.loDetails: (Basic Knowledge) Understand the way people thinking about Arts - Aesthetics.

(Research Skills) Understand the contexts of the main styles and movements in Art History, which related to important inventions in manufacture, significant events on the market, talented and pioneering Artist.
(Critical Thinking) Analyze the records of the past in Art and Phylosophy History.
(Communication Skills): Study optional cases in aesthetic history, organize and express the individual thoughts clearly and coherently both in orally (presentations) and writing (assignments/essays).
Be aware of what is aesthetics and understand the stages of aesthetic awareness in history
Evaluate manual and/or digital art works, media and materials appropriately to produce creative ways solutions for specific cultural and technical contexts.
Having a professional style in arts activity. Love to research in visual arts.
Students have a proficient in presentation and teamworks.
